python3 -c '
# Triangulate Chair 2 across obs 83, 84, 85:
import cv2, numpy as np

img85 = cv2.imread("/work/observations/obs_0085.png")
mask85 = (img85[:,:,2] > 90) & (img85[:,:,2] < 160) & (img85[:,:,1] > 40) & (img85[:,:,1] < 80) & (img85[:,:,0] < 40)

ys2, xs2 = np.where(mask85[:, 130:260])
xs2 += 130
print(f"Chair 2 in obs 85: x=[{xs2.min()}, {xs2.max()}], width={xs2.max()-xs2.min()+1}, bottom_y={ys2.max()}")

X_cams = np.array([0.7312, 0.2312, -0.2688])
ws = np.array([64.0, 76.0, 95.0])
inv_w = 1.0 / ws

slope, intercept = np.polyfit(X_cams, inv_w, 1)
# inv_w = slope * X_cam + intercept = 0 when X_cam = -intercept / slope
X_chair = -intercept / slope
print(f"Multi-view fit Chair 2 X: {X_chair:.4f} m")

# Ground contact row in obs 85:
by85 = ys2.max()
cx2_85 = (xs2.min() + xs2.max()) / 2.0
d85 = 256.0 * 1.55 / (by85 - 255.5)
Xc85 = (cx2_85 - 255.5) / 256.0 * d85
print(f"Obs 85 depth: {d85:.4f} m => X = {-0.2688 - d85:.4f} m, Y = {4.5972 + Xc85:.4f} m")
'
